Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style

Class OgcFilters

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilters
public final class OgcFilters extends Object
Static factory class for OGC Filter predicates used in SldBuilder rules.

Mirrors the GeoTools FilterFactory API without requiring any GeoTools dependency. Provides factory methods for:

  • Comparison — equalTo(java.lang.String, java.lang.String), notEqualTo(java.lang.String, java.lang.String), greaterThan(java.lang.String, java.lang.Number), greaterThanOrEqualTo(java.lang.String, java.lang.Number), lessThan(java.lang.String, java.lang.Number), lessThanOrEqualTo(java.lang.String, java.lang.Number)
  • Range / pattern / null — between(java.lang.String, java.lang.Number, java.lang.Number), like(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String), isNull(java.lang.String)
  • Spatial — bbox(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry), intersects(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry), contains(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry), within(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry), disjoint(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry), touches(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry), crosses(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry), overlaps(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry), spatialEquals(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry), dWithin(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry, double, java.lang.String), beyond(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry, double, java.lang.String)
  • Identity — featureId(java.lang.String...), gmlObjectId(java.lang.String...)
  • Logical — and(io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilter...), or(io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilter...), not(io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilter)

Every method returns an OgcFilter instance that serializes to the corresponding OGC Filter Encoding 1.0 XML fragment when appended by SldBuilder into a <ogc:Filter> element.

Comparison methods come in two overloaded forms:

  1. String / Number shorthand — wraps both sides automatically in <ogc:PropertyName> and <ogc:Literal>.
  2. SldExpression overload — gives full control; use when either operand is an OGC function, arithmetic expression, or any non-trivial expression.

Typical usage


 import static io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilters.*;
 import static io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldExpression.*;

 // Simple attribute comparison
 OgcFilter simple = equalTo("road_type", "highway");

 // Numeric range
 OgcFilter range = between("population", 100_000, 1_000_000);

 // Pattern match
 OgcFilter pattern = like("name", "New*");

 // Spatial — features within a bounding box
 OgcFilter spatial = bbox("the_geom", -180, -90, 180, 90, "EPSG:4326");

 // OGC function on the left operand
 OgcFilter fnFilter = equalTo(
     function("strToLowerCase", property("road_type")),
     literal("highway"));

 // Compound logical filter
 OgcFilter compound = and(
     greaterThan("population", 500_000),
     not(equalTo("country", "excluded"))
 );
Since:
1.0.0

    • equalTo

      public static OgcFilter equalTo(SldExpression left, SldExpression right)
      Creates an <ogc:PropertyIsEqualTo> filter using arbitrary SldExpression operands — left = right.

      Use this overload when either side is an OGC function, arithmetic expression, or any expression that cannot be expressed as a plain property name or literal string: 

      
 equalTo(function("strToLowerCase", property("road_type")), literal("highway"))
      Parameters:
      left - the left-hand operand expression
      right - the right-hand operand expression
      Returns:
      an OgcFilter representing the expression equality predicate

    • like

      public static OgcFilter like(String property, String pattern, String wildCard, String singleChar, String escape)
      Creates an <ogc:PropertyIsLike> filter for wildcard pattern matching.

      Generates: 

      
 <ogc:PropertyIsLike wildCard="*" singleChar="." escape="!">
   <ogc:PropertyName>name</ogc:PropertyName>
   <ogc:Literal>New*</ogc:Literal>
 </ogc:PropertyIsLike>
      Parameters:
      property - the feature attribute name to match against
      pattern - the pattern string; use wildCard to match any substring and singleChar to match any single character
      wildCard - the multi-character wildcard character (commonly "*")
      singleChar - the single-character wildcard character (commonly ".")
      escape - the escape character used to treat wildcard chars as literals (commonly "!")
      Returns:
      an OgcFilter representing the LIKE predicate

    • bbox

      public static OgcFilter bbox(String property, SldGeometry geometry)
      Creates an <ogc:BBOX> spatial filter — true when the feature geometry intersects the given SldGeometry envelope.

      Generates: 

      
 <ogc:BBOX>
   <ogc:PropertyName>the_geom</ogc:PropertyName>
   <gml:Box srsName="EPSG:4326">
     <gml:coordinates>-180,-90 180,90</gml:coordinates>
   </gml:Box>
 </ogc:BBOX>
      Parameters:
      property - the geometry attribute name (e.g. "the_geom")
      geometry - the bounding envelope; create with SldGeometry.envelope(double, double, double, double, String)
      Returns:
      an OgcFilter representing the BBOX predicate

    • bbox

      public static OgcFilter bbox(String property, double minX, double minY, double maxX, double maxY, String srsName)
      Creates an <ogc:BBOX> filter with explicit coordinates and SRS.

    • featureId

      public static OgcFilter featureId(String... fids)
      Creates an <ogc:FeatureId> filter that selects features by their WFS feature ID.

      Multiple IDs form an implicit OR — a feature matches if its ID equals any of the supplied values. Generates one <ogc:FeatureId fid="…"/> element per ID.

      Feature IDs have the form typeName.localId, e.g. "roads.1": 

      
 featureId("roads.1", "roads.2", "roads.3")
      Parameters:
      fids - one or more feature identifier strings
      Returns:
      an OgcFilter that matches features with any of the given IDs

    • gmlObjectId

      public static OgcFilter gmlObjectId(String... gmlIds)
      Creates an <ogc:GmlObjectId> filter that selects GML objects by their gml:id attribute.

      Alternative to featureId(java.lang.String...) for GML 3+ / WFS 1.1 resources where the object identifier is carried in the gml:id XML attribute rather than a WFS feature ID. Multiple IDs form an implicit OR: 

      
 gmlObjectId("roads.1", "roads.2")
      Parameters:
      gmlIds - one or more GML object identifier strings
      Returns:
      an OgcFilter that matches GML objects with any of the given IDs

      public static OgcFilter and(OgcFilter... filters)
      Creates an <ogc:And> logical filter — all supplied sub-filters must match.

 <ogc:And>

    • or

      public static OgcFilter or(OgcFilter... filters)
      Creates an <ogc:Or> logical filter — at least one sub-filter must match.

      Generates: 

      
 <ogc:Or>
   <!-- filter1 -->
   <!-- filter2 -->
 </ogc:Or>
      Parameters:
      filters - two or more filters to combine with logical OR
      Returns:
      an OgcFilter that is true when any of filters is true

    • not

      public static OgcFilter not(OgcFilter filter)
      Creates an <ogc:Not> logical filter — the sub-filter must not match.

      Generates: 

      
 <ogc:Not>
   <!-- filter -->
 </ogc:Not>
      Parameters:
      filter - the filter to negate
      Returns:
      an OgcFilter that is true when filter is false
